statement: A change to a file under a full-corpus trigger directory that does not define the push gate is proved by its own cone, not by the whole corpus; the trigger directories stay fail-closed. The two directory rules of FULL_CORPUS_TRIGGER_RULES (selection-state: test/manifests/; push-gate: .githooks/) stay, so any file under them - a new one included - still runs the whole corpus, and each rule exempts by name exactly the files proven not to define the gate, each exemption carrying a one-line reason naming its only consumers. A file is proven not to define the gate only when nothing the gate runs names it (the files that trip a trigger, the package scripts they run through npm, transitively, and the import closure of every script they name) and a test observes it by name in the observation census; an exemption is witnessed to fail when either stops holding. Witnessed on the real selection through buildExecutionPlan and decidePushProof: a change to test/manifests/pre-push-stages.json (the incident: a ~40-minute full corpus for a file read only by the apparatus budget, whose 179-test cone already held both its observers) and to every other exempted file runs the change proof with its named observers in the cone; a change to the post-push manifest, proof-obligations.json, the safety spine, the impact contracts, .githooks/pre-push, any unexempted file under a trigger directory, or a new unlisted file under test/manifests/ or .githooks/ runs the whole corpus. .githooks/pre-push itself stays a trigger (dropping it is an owner decision not made here). No script, workflow or gate is added or weakened.

constraints.statement: The directory rules stay and exemptions are named files; a file not named, including a new one, keeps triggering the whole corpus.

An exemption is valid only while nothing the gate runs names the file and a test observes it by name; both are derived in the witness from the trigger rules, package.json, the import graph and the observation census, never from a retyped list of modules.
.githooks/pre-push, the post-push manifest, proof-obligations.json, the safety spine and the impact contracts remain full-corpus triggers.
No script or workflow is added; the witnesses live in the existing gate test file; ratchets move one way only.
